_doc: Stages (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md 4.1). This file holds the notes and `progression`; the stages themselves are one file per region, `stages/<key>.json`, each holding that stage object and merged into `stages` by DataRepo.load_stages in progression order (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4, spec #449 C0), so parallel region tickets never edit one file. A stage: region stage key -> ordered maps with one boss and pool rule each, map_seconds (boss delay from map entry), round duration (s), pacing keyframes, bursts, elites. Keyframe numbers (rate = mobs/s, max_alive, hp and speed multipliers) interpolate linearly in time between keyframes; the pool (mob id -> weight) is the one of the last keyframe at or before t. Bursts: every `every` s from `first`, a ring of count_min..count_max mobs (growing with time) around the view, allowed past max_alive up to `hard_cap`. Elites: every `every` s from `first`, one mob of the current pool with hp_mult x HP, exp_mult x EXP and damage_mult x mitigated damage. spawn: overrides of balance.json spawn for this region. exp_mult: EXP multiplier of this stage. note: a line shown on the stage card. region and continent (both required, tier C owner choice #221): the town the player sees as the stage name and the small line above or beside it; they replace the WZ map and street names everywhere. original_life is the map's own spawn list (shown on the stage card). Potions are unlimited on per-kind cooldowns; no potion drops exist (spec #237). Boss summon and revive mob ids are not listed here: they come from the bosses' canonical MobSkill 200 and info/revive data (StageRoster). All numbers tier C (ours).
_progression: Tier C (ADR 0007, owner request 2026-10-30; spec #447): the ordered region keys of the game, in the order a v83 character levelled. A character starts with the first one open; clearing a region (its last map's boss dead, round CLEARED) opens the next (CharacterSnapshot.cleared_regions, SceneFlow.unlocked_stages). Replaces the run tiers of spec #32 and the owner region lists of spec #241 (Perion and Kerning City added by spec #253). Every key must exist in `stages`, appear once and carry a drop_band (DataRepo.progression_errors). A stage outside the list stays loadable for --run/--stage tools only.
_drop_band: Tier C (ADR 0006 #292 per tier, ADR 0007 / spec #447 per region; owner call): each stage's `drop_band` is the [min, max] reqLevel its equipment drops come from, rising along the progression. Ordinary drops pick inside the band, bosses from its top third (equipment_drops.json boss_top_parts). The band replaces the character-level window: a round always starts at Lv1. A stage without one drops from any reqLevel (EquipmentDrops.band_of).
